name: MATLI v1.5 Clinical Safety, Personalization & Selection Matrix
boundary: This engine is a clinician/research decision-support layer. Missing safety data never means safe. It does not replace the applicable official monograph, STG/CPG, licensed product label, pharmacovigilance review or patient-specific clinical judgment.

selection_policy.drug_of_choice: Do not label a formulation as Drug of Choice / first-line / preferred unless an explicit authoritative guideline or protocol supports that wording.
selection_policy.priority: Priority is a research-navigation order based on evidence layer, condition match and conservative safety flags; it is not an autonomous prescription ranking.
selection_policy.missing_data: Unknown / not source-verified safety is displayed as REVIEW REQUIRED, never as SAFE.

E1.label: E1 • Condition-linked clinical evidence
E1.meaning: Curated MATLI formulation linked to a condition-specific government/institutional clinical study, protocol or treatment resource in this build.

E2.label: E2 • Curated official/classical source layer
E2.meaning: Curated formulation with official/classical source families, but no condition-specific protocol embedded for the current search.

D.label: D • AFI discovery only
D.meaning: Formulary-index therapeutic-use match. Useful for discovery; not a ranked treatment recommendation.

status_labels.protocol_example: Protocol example available — not universal dose

class_rules.note: High-caution herbo-mineral/mineral-rich class: verify exact composition/version, Shodhana/Marana or applicable processing, licensed quality, dose, organ function, special-population suitability, interactions and monitoring.
Asava/Arishta or fermented formulation: verify alcohol content, sugar/content, label, hepatic context, age/special-population suitability and interacting medicines.
Avaleha/Leha: verify sugar/base composition, dose, swallowing/metabolic context and licensed label.
Kshara/alkali-containing formulation: exact formulation, route, GI/mucosal tolerance and special-population context require verification.
No formulation should be considered cleared for a special population solely because a warning is absent.

source_hierarchy.label: Government treatment protocol / STG / essential-medicine resource

selection_framework.name: Ayurveda individualized medicine-selection verification framework
selection_framework.boundary: These domains organize clinician review. They do not prove that a formulation is suitable for a patient unless formulation-specific source evidence is available.

domains.label: Roga / diagnosis & avastha
domains.verify: Confirm diagnosis, stage/avastha, severity, red flags and important differentials.

domains.label: Prakriti
domains.verify: Document constitutional context when clinically relevant; do not infer drug suitability from Prakriti alone.

domains.label: Vikriti / dominant Dosha
domains.verify: Confirm current pathological Dosha pattern and subtype/state where relevant.

domains.label: Agni + Ama/Nirama
domains.verify: Review digestive/metabolic state because Matra, Anupana, Kala and formulation tolerance may differ.

domains.label: Koshtha
domains.verify: Document bowel constitution/tendency when it changes selection, dose or adjuvant.

domains.label: Rogi Bala + Roga Bala
domains.verify: Review disease burden, reserve, frailty and treatment intensity.

domains.label: Satmya + Vaya
domains.verify: Review age, habituation/tolerance, diet and special-population limitations.

domains.label: Desha + Kala / season
domains.verify: Use only when the classical/clinical context materially affects selection.

domains.label: Concurrent medicines & comorbidity
domains.verify: Check herb–drug/Ayurveda–modern interactions, organ function and duplicate ingredients.

domains.label: Identity, quality & source
domains.verify: Verify exact formulation version, ingredients/process, licensed manufacturer, batch/expiry and API/AFI/official monograph where applicable.

domains.label: Matra + Anupana + Aushadha Sevana Kala
domains.verify: Verify exact dose, frequency, route, Anupana, meal timing/Kala and age-specific instructions from a source.

domains.label: Duration + monitoring + stop criteria
domains.verify: Define review interval, maximum duration if known, response/ADR monitoring and stop/escalation criteria.
